column1: # ATIRadeonX1000 per-use renames, part C: start(), set_display_mode_and_vram, initialize_hardware, start_promo4_engine, setup_R500_internal_space (rows kept only if the compiled objects stay byte-identical: Tools/renames/filter_rows.py)

column6: evidence
IOATIR500Accelerator::start's return value: zero returns false at once
the counter of the two-entry table of 0x20-byte records at +0x940 that is zeroed here
ATIR500Memory::init_pool's result: zero releases the pool object again
the register window pointer: stored to self+0x860, and the chip-ID/revision strobe sequence reads and writes registers + 8..0xf
startupPCIeGART's result: -1 skips the rest of the bring-up
the result of the first vtable +0x590 call (maps the buffer at self+0x228 into the GART at offset 0): zero skips the mapping loops
the GART page number of the loop: gartOffset = pageIndex << page_shift for each page mapped after the first
the number of bytes (rounded to the cache line) of self+0x238 + 0x20 to push out with dcbst before dcbf: the loop runs while the flushed length is below it
HZMEM_Init's result: zero continues
the SWDS timer event source: stored to self+0x9b8 and added to the work loop (vtable +0xe4 on self+0xb4)
the index of the sensor-properties array being walked (vtable +0x138 getObject(index))
the register at +0xf8 (the memory size read at start-up), stored to self+0x9c, with a default of 8 MB when it reads zero
self+0x84c, the video memory size capped at 128 MB (0x8000000), the pool size passed to init_pool
start_promo4_engine(4)'s result: zero makes initialize_hardware return false
set_display_mode_and_vram's result: zero logs "set_display_mode_and_vram failed" and returns false
the register window pointer (self+0x860): every register access of the rest of the bring-up is registers + offset
the ring write index (self+0x914) read before the 0x5c9 packet is queued: ring[writeIndex] = 0x5c9, the next word at (writeIndex + 1) & 0x7ff
the command ring base (self+0x900) the 0x5c9 packet is written into
(writeIndex + 1) & 0x7ff: where the packet's second word goes, then the index stored back to self+0x914 as (nextWriteIndex + 1) & 0x7ff
the register window pointer (self+0x860): the ring control register is +0x704
self+0x90c, the base of the ring write-pointer mirror: the write pointer is stored at ringPointerBase + self+0x910, and its distance from self+0x238 is added to the GART address for register +0x70c
the number of RBBM_STATUS polls (1 ms apart) so far: 0xf4241 means the engine never went idle and start_promo4_engine returns false
the index of the two-entry table of 0x20-byte display records (+0xe4 tested, self[0x80] set when one is active)
register +0xe40 (RBBM_STATUS, as printed by dump_registers): the idle test is (status & 0x10200) == 0
self+0x98, the chip capability flags word (bit 0x400000 selects the 0x70 register value, the same flags start() ORs 0x110000.. into)
